# awscc_route53globalresolver_core_network_endpoint (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::Route53GlobalResolver::CoreNetworkEndpoint



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the core network endpoint.
- `available_regions` (List of String) Regions where the endpoint can serve DNS: the Global Resolver regions that are also core network edge locations.
- `client_token` (String)
- `core_network_arn` (String) The ARN of the AWS Cloud WAN core network to connect. The core network must be in the same account and AVAILABLE. A core network can have one core network endpoint.
- `core_network_endpoint_id` (String) The ID of the core network endpoint.
- `created_at` (String)
- `global_resolver_id` (String) The ID of the Global Resolver to connect. A Global Resolver can have one core network endpoint.
- `ip_addresses` (Attributes List) The private DNS IP addresses of the endpoint (1 to 5). Each IP address can appear once. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ip_addresses))
- `name` (String) A name for the core network endpoint.
- `status` (String) CREATING, OPERATIONAL, UPDATING or DELETING. The service can also report FAILURE or ACTION_NEEDED, so this is not an enum.
- `tags` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
- `updated_at` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--ip_addresses"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ip_addresses`

Read-Only:

- `dns_label` (String) Lowercase DNS label for the IP address. The service appends the endpoint ID to build the DNS name. The label of an existing IP address cannot be changed; to use a new label, change the IP address too.
- `ipv_4_address` (String)
- `ipv_6_address` (String)
- `region_scope` (String) ALL to serve the IP address in every available region of the endpoint, or REGIONAL to serve it only in Regions.
- `regions` (Set of String) Regions that serve the IP address. Required when RegionScope is REGIONAL and not allowed when it is ALL. Must be a subset of AvailableRegions.


<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Read-Only:

- `key` (String)
- `value` (String)
